name: Do green buildings cost more to build?

mainEntity.name: Do green buildings cost more to build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Green homes typically cost 2-5% more upfront but save 20-40% on energy bills annually; certifications like NGBS show payback through 8-12 years via reduced operating costs. nahb​
